title: Continual pairing requests after recent Android update.
body:
I'm on 11-27 daily. Having problems with a constant android pair request notifications that I cannot silence or connect. "Unpair before bonding" is not checked.

"Could not read reply to auth challenge....."

"Prompting user to notice pairing request with sound. On android 10+ you have to manually pair when requested." are a couple of errors seen.

@cutlerphoto Hi,
There should be no frequent pair request as soon as you update to an xDrip release of November 27, 2020 or later.
If you have updated and are still experiencing the pair request, please confirm.
Otherwise, would you please close this issue?

If there is problem with maintaining connectivity, we can help you, but that is a different issue, not related to what is described in the title of this isuue..
It does actually still happen if I'm away from the phone for 5 minutes when it attempts a read. It then fails to bond again without a restart. Airplane mode can also fix it.
